## Goal

Generate **one standalone script** that writes a PDF file to disk. Do NOT create
component libraries, types files, data files, download buttons, barrel exports,
or any other files inside the user's application source code.

Output:

```
<frontend-dir>/scripts/generate-report.tsx   ← the script (created by the skill)
docs/<project>-report.pdf                    ← the PDF (generated by running the script)
```

For non-TypeScript projects, use `.jsx` instead of `.tsx`. The `tsx` runner
handles both extensions — it does not require the target project to use
TypeScript. The only Node dependencies are `@react-pdf/renderer` and `tsx`.

The script lives inside the frontend project directory (next to `package.json`)
so it can resolve `react` and `@react-pdf/renderer` from `node_modules`.

---

## Setup

The script needs `@react-pdf/renderer` available. Install it as a dev dependency:

```bash
npm install -D @react-pdf/renderer
```

Run the script with `tsx` (or `ts-node`). `tsx` handles both `.tsx` and `.jsx`:

```bash
# TypeScript project
npx tsx scripts/generate-report.tsx

# JavaScript project
npx tsx scripts/generate-report.jsx
```

---

## Core Components

| Component | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `<Document>` | Root wrapper — contains one or more `<Page>` |
| `<Page>` | A single PDF page with size and margins |
| `<View>` | Layout container (like `<div>`) — supports flexbox |
| `<Text>` | Text content (like `<span>` / `<p>`) |
| `<Link>` | Hyperlink |
| `<Svg>`, `<Rect>`, `<Line>`, `<G>`, `<Path>`, `<Circle>` | SVG primitives for diagrams |

### Important Constraints

- No HTML — only react-pdf primitives.
- No CSS classes — use `StyleSheet.create()` or inline `style` objects.
- Flexbox is the only layout model (no grid, no float).
- `<Text>` cannot contain `<View>` — only other `<Text>` or strings.
- `<View>` cannot contain bare strings — wrap in `<Text>`.
- SVG `<Text>` inside `<Svg>` uses different props than layout `<Text>`.
  Import as `Text as SvgText` to avoid conflicts. If TypeScript complains
  about `fontSize`/`fontFamily` on `SvgText`, cast it:
  ```tsx
  const SvgLabel = SvgText as React.ComponentType<Record<string, unknown>>;
  ```

## Single-File Script Template

Everything lives in **one file**: data, styles, components, and the render call.

```tsx
// scripts/generate-report.tsx
import React from "react";
import {
  Document,
  Page,
  Text,
  View,
  StyleSheet,
  Svg,
  G,
  Rect,
  Line,
  Path,
  Text as SvgText,
  renderToFile,
} from "@react-pdf/renderer";
import * as fs from "node:fs";

// ─── Cast for SVG Text (incomplete TS types) ────────────────────────
const SvgLabel = SvgText as React.ComponentType<Record<string, unknown>>;

// ─── Analysis Data (inline — no separate file) ──────────────────────
const data = {
  projectName: "My Project",
  generatedDate: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
  techStack: [
    { category: "Framework", name: "React", version: "19.1.0", status: "current" },
    // ... all entries inline
  ],
  features: [
    {
      name: "auth",
      path: "src/features/auth/",
      internalModules: ["LoginForm", "useAuth"],
      dependencies: [{ target: "API", type: "shared" }],
      apiEndpoints: ["/api/auth/login"],
    },
    // ...
  ],
  layers: [
    { name: "Routes", directories: ["src/routes/"] },
    { name: "Features", directories: ["src/features/"] },
    // ...
  ],
  violations: [],
  recommendations: [
    {
      category: "Bundle Size",
      score: 4,
      summary: "No major issues.",
      items: ["Add route-level code splitting"],
    },
    // ...
  ],
  productionDeps: [{ name: "react", version: "19.1.0" }],
  devDeps: [{ name: "vite", version: "7.0.0" }],
};

// ─── Styles ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const styles = StyleSheet.create({ /* ... see Style System section */ });

// ─── SVG Diagram Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────
// (DiagramNode, Arrow, FeatureDependencyDiagram, ArchitectureLayersDiagram)
// See diagram-generation.md for full implementations.

// ─── Page Components (all in this file) ─────────────────────────────
const TitlePage = () => (
  <Page size="A4" style={styles.page}>
    <View style={{ flex: 1, justifyContent: "center", alignItems: "center" }}>
      <Text style={styles.title}>Frontend Architecture Report</Text>
      <Text style={{ fontSize: 18, color: "#475569", marginTop: 12 }}>
        {data.projectName}
      </Text>
      <Text style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#94a3b8", marginTop: 8 }}>
        Generated {data.generatedDate}
      </Text>
    </View>
  </Page>
);

// ... TechStackPage, FeatureMapPage, DiagramPages, RecommendationsPage, AppendixPage

// ─── Main Document ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
const Report = () => (
  <Document>
    <TitlePage />
    {/* ... all other pages */}
  </Document>
);

// ─── Write PDF to disk ──────────────────────────────────────────────
const outputDir = "docs";
if (!fs.existsSync(outputDir)) fs.mkdirSync(outputDir, { recursive: true });

const outputPath = `${outputDir}/${data.projectName.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-")}-architecture-report.pdf`;
await renderToFile(<Report />, outputPath);
console.log(`✅ Report written to ${outputPath}`);
```

### Key Principles

1. **One file** — all data, styles, components, and render logic in a single script.
2. **No app integration** — the script runs standalone, outside the app's source.
3. **No types file** — define the data shape inline or use the constant directly.
4. **No download button** — `renderToFile()` writes to disk. Done.
5. **`scripts/` directory** — lives at project root, not inside `src/`.
6. **`docs/` output** — PDF goes in `docs/` (create the directory if needed).

---

## Running the Script

```bash
# Install dependencies (one-time)
npm install -D @react-pdf/renderer

# Generate the PDF
npx tsx scripts/generate-report.tsx
```

The script exits after writing the file. No server, no browser, no build step.
